resources.string: Follow the original line with remaining distance, estimated time and distance from the track. No turn-by-turn instructions or automatic rerouting. Guidance works while the app is open; reopen the GPX to restart after closing the app. Time is an estimate; missing elevation data can make it too optimistic.
The file was sent for import as a map track. Guidance currently supports GPX with one continuous segment and up to 20,000 points. KML, KMZ and multi-segment files can be viewed on the map.
